details: Malicious package. Advertised as string helpers (toUpperCase, reverseString, ...), but the postinstall hook spawns `index.js` as a detached background process. It opens a raw TCP connection to 47.251.102.182:8057, reports the OS type, and accepts commands from the server, including FILE_START/FILE_END framing that writes server-supplied content to an arbitrary server-chosen path on the host, and runs every other line it receives as a shell command via child_process.exec (prefixed with `chcp 65001` on Windows), sending the output back: a reverse shell. In a sandboxed install the package connected to 47.251.102.182.
